findings.label: Pointer focus without hover
findings.detail: Without the pointer-down guard, a tap or click on an unfocused OptionList with no prior mousemove briefly puts a keyboard highlight on the first option before mouseup selects the tapped row. Embedded Multiselect on main does the same; accepted trade-off, revisit with follow-up 4.

findings.label: Scroll page preselection is now inert for focus
findings.detail: pages/option-list/scroll.page.tsx still offers 'Already selected: Option 81' while focus now lands on Option 1. Keep it for the follow-up or add a comment.
